backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing e-commerce backend with product management (CRUD operations with categories, pricing, featured flags), user profiles, role-based access control (admin/user roles), session management, and blob storage integration for product images.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old actor state (with blog posts, newsletter signups, page contents, and admin credentials) to new simplified actor state containing only products, discarding all other legacy data.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON file with no documented features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components, hooks, and configuration files, documenting React app structure with product management, admin panel, authentication, optimized styling with WCAG-compliant colors, and enhanced Amazon product metadata extraction in backend.
frontend/CLOUDFLARE_CDN_SETUP.md: Step-by-step guide for configuring Cloudflare CDN optimizations including auto-minify, Brotli compression, Rocket Loader, caching rules, image optimization (Polish/WebP), HTTP/3, Early Hints, and performance monitoring with verification and troubleshooting steps.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_TROUBLESHOOTING.md: Deployment troubleshooting documentation covering production failure resolution (missing favicon reference), Version 84 go-live checklist with pre-deployment verification steps for static assets, build verification, critical routes, service worker registration, and common deployment issues with solutions.
frontend/index.html: Main HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, structured data for Kolkata-based fashion affiliate site, and preloaded critical assets (hero banner, logo).
frontend/PERFORMANCE_ACTION_PLAN.md: Performance optimization action plan targeting Lighthouse scores of 90+ mobile and 95+ desktop, identifying current issues (large JS bundles, unoptimized images, render-blocking CSS) and outlining Phase 1 quick wins including Cloudflare optimizations with specific configuration steps.
frontend/PERFORMANCE_OPTIMIZATION.md: Comprehensive performance optimization guide documenting implemented techniques including critical path rendering (inline CSS, resource hints), advanced image optimization (responsive srcset, AVIF/WebP, lazy loading), code splitting with React.lazy, service worker caching strategies, Core Web Vitals tracking, React Query optimization, and CSS/animation performance enhancements.
frontend/public/robots.txt: Robots.txt file allowing all crawlers and pointing to sitemap.xml.
frontend/public/sitemap.xml: XML sitemap with single homepage entry, daily change frequency, and priority 1.0.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets, network-first for HTML/API, with versioned cache management and special handling for robots.txt/sitemap.xml.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component with lazy-loaded routes (home, products, admin, sitemap), authentication handling, blog modal state, and route-based rendering logic.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlogManage: Placeholder admin component that displays a message indicating blog management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/admin/Newsletter: Placeholder admin component that displays a message indicating newsletter management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductMan: Admin component for managing products with CRUD operations (add, edit, delete), form validation, category management, and integration with React Query hooks for product data.
frontend/src/components/admin/SitePagesM: Placeholder admin component that displays a message indicating site pages management functionality has been removed from this version.
frontend/src/components/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login modal component with username/password form, error handling, and integration with useAuth hook.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel container with tabbed interface for products, blog, newsletter, and site pages management, including admin permission checks and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/BlogPostModal.ts: Dialog modal component displaying a message that blog functionality has been removed.
frontend/src/components/BlogTeaser.tsx: Memoized component that returns null, effectively hiding the blog teaser section.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with newsletter signup form (disabled), quick links, Kolkata location badge, social media links, trust badges, and Amazon affiliate disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header component with logo, navigation links (Home, Products, Admin), and client-side routing using pushState. Includes active route highlighting and responsive layout.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero banner section with gradient background, call-to-action buttons for shopping/browsing, and trust badges. Includes smooth scroll to products section.
frontend/src/components/OptimizedImage.t: Image component with lazy loading, intersection observer for viewport detection, WebP format support with PNG fallback, and responsive srcset generation for performance optimization.
frontend/src/components/PageModal.tsx: Modal component displaying static content for privacy policy, terms of service, and contact pages with close button and scrollable content area.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Product listing component with filtering by category/price, sorting options, and memoized product cards displaying images, prices, discounts, and Amazon affiliate links. Includes loading and empty states.
frontend/src/components/SocialProof.tsx: Social proof section displaying customer testimonials with star ratings and an auto-rotating carousel of recent purchases to build trust.
frontend/src/components/Spinner.tsx: Simple animated SVG spinner component for loading states with customizable className and accessibility attributes.
frontend/src/components/TrustBadges.tsx: React component that displays trust badges (Kolkata-based, Amazon Associates, secure checkout, money-back guarantee, SSL) with configurable horizontal or vertical layout and lazy-loaded images.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance with Internet Identity authentication, creating authenticated or anonymous actors and invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAuth.ts: Zustand-based authentication store with session management that has been deprecated in favor of Internet Identity, throwing errors on custom login attempts.
frontend/src/hooks/useDebounce.ts: Custom React hooks providing debounced value updates and debounced callback functions with configurable delay (default 300ms) for performance optimization.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for product and admin operations including fetching products by category, filtering, and CRUD mutations with optimized caching (5-10 minute stale/cache times) and toast notifications.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom gold/navy color scheme using OKLCH color space, including light/dark mode support and WCAG AA+ compliant color variables.
frontend/src/lib/web-vitals.d.ts: TypeScript type definitions for the web-vitals library, defining metric interfaces and report handler functions for Core Web Vitals monitoring.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin page component that handles authentication flow, checks admin permissions, and conditionally renders AdminLogin or AdminPanel based on user status.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Products listing page with a header section and ProductGrid component for displaying the complete product catalog.
frontend/src/pages/SitemapPage.tsx: Generates and renders a basic XML sitemap dynamically with URLs for home and products pages using the backend canister ID.
frontend/src/utils/delayedScripts.ts: Utility for delaying third-party script injection by 3 seconds after page load to improve Core Web Vitals performance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both standard query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence for parameters like admin tokens.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the theme with custom gold/navy colors, OKLCH color system integration, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite build configuration with React plugin, API proxy setup, optimized production builds with code splitting for vendor chunks, and terser minification.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document indicating pending feature requests to add a Filter button and restore Version 89 product catalog data.
